basic_info.description:
This Grand Victorian-era home in highly sought-after Noe Valley offers a perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience. 3br/3ba, home features a versatile bonus space downstairs that opens onto a private deck and spacious backyard, ideal for outdoor living. Beautifully refinished Brazilian teak floors create a warm & inviting atmosphere. The large, well-appointed kitchen comes with stainless steel appliances, and the light-filled enclosed porch off the kitchen is a perfect spot for enjoying your coffee. The home has 
been freshly repainted, showcasing its timeless appeal. The original built-in cabinet adds character to the formal dining room. Classic period details, such as wainscotting & ceiling medallions highlight the homes Victorian architecture, with the pocket doors providing flexibility in creating open spaces or separate rooms as desired. Upstairs bedrooms are bathed in natural light thanks to large skylights that fill the rooms with warmth & brightness. Large one-car garage with additional storage space. Convenient location, just a few blocks from vibrant 24th Street with its boutique shops, restaurants, the popular Farmers Market & Whole Foods. An ideal blend of historic elegance & contemporary comfort in one of San Franciscos most desirable neighborhoods.
